title: Say where the sign-in is kept
steps: Start Mail without an account and read the line under Sign in with Google
After signing in, open Settings › Accounts
expected: On a build whose sign-ins sync, both say: Your sign-in is kept in your Keychain and syncs through iCloud Keychain if you have it turned on. On a build that can't sync, both say: Your sign-in is kept in this Mac's Keychain.
